# Support

[简体中文](SUPPORT.md) | **English**

Only the latest release is maintained. The project does not promise a commercial
service level or fixed response time. Before reporting a problem, upgrade to the
latest version and read:

- [README user guide](../docs/README.en.md#user-guide)
- [Common scenarios](../docs/en/quick-start.md)
- [Troubleshooting](../docs/en/troubleshooting.md)
- [Compatibility and known limitations](../docs/en/compatibility.md)
- [Local diagnostics](../docs/en/diagnostics.md)

## Prepare a report

If the problem remains, record:

- Assistant version and distribution: GitHub Release, AHK source, or a self-built EXE.
- Windows version, OS build, and x64 architecture.
- Display scale, resolution, monitor count, and which monitor contains the affected window.
- Target type, administrator requirement, shortcut use, and update-protection state.
- Shortest reproduction, frequency, expected result, and actual result.
- Redacted log excerpts, diagnostics, screenshots, or recordings.

Logs and diagnostics may contain local paths, launch arguments, or environment
variables. Remove anything you do not want to publish. The project does not
upload diagnostics automatically.

## Choose the right form

- Use Bug Report for reproducible functional defects, monitoring mistakes, or UI problems.
- Use Feature Request for a capability or complete workflow that does not exist today.
- Use Improvement for a change to existing behavior, UI, performance, compatibility, or design.
- See [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.en.md) for development and pull-request requirements.

Do not open an issue requesting Windows-service, driver, cross-session service,
or non-Windows support; these targets are outside the project scope.

## Security issues

Anything that may affect another user's data or system integrity must not be
posted as an ordinary public issue. Follow the
[security policy](SECURITY.en.md) and use GitHub Private vulnerability reporting.
